_doc: MusicManager config (owned by the music role, see docs/team/music.md). Track ids are the keys of res://assets/audio/music/manifest.json (written by tools/music/gen_music.py). Aliases: '@map' = the music of the current/selected map (Maps def 'music'), '@menu' = 'basecamp' while the Basecamp Hell hub is loaded, else 'title'.
_boss_tracks_doc: Boss id (the boss's EnemyData file name, e.g. data/bosses/grand_inquisitor.tres) -> track.
_map_tracks_doc: Map id -> track, overriding the map definition's 'music' (used when a map JSON still points at a shared theme).
_story_doc: Story music: the hub plays 'ended_basecamp' once Dialogue.has_flag(ended_flag); the staged ending plays 'ending_track' and reacts to Dialogue.event_triggered stage_* events (archons/throne layers, sit/break resolutions).
_quantize_doc: Track switches wait for the playing track's next bar line (or 'beat' for urgent switches like a boss arriving). Bars longer than 'max_bar_wait' seconds quantize to half bars.
_stingers_doc: Event -> one-shot stinger, started on the playing track's next beat. duck = music dip in dB while it rings; priority: a playing stinger is not interrupted by a lower one; cooldown in seconds per event. Relic (relic_<rarity>) and level_up events are hooked but off by default (the SFX role covers them): render them with `python tools/music/gen_music.py sting_relics sting_level_up` and add entries here to turn them on.

intensity._doc: Run intensity: 0 calm (base stem), 1 combat (+combat stem), 2 frenzy (+frenzy stem). Raises are instant, drops wait 'hold' seconds and go one step at a time. Wave surges and active objectives bump it.
